_about: Your own known clashes, for sf-load-order --clashes. Made-up plugin names: replace them with yours. An entry shows when at least `min` of its plugins are enabled (default: all of them).

clashes.note: Both change the same armor pieces; the one loading last wins.
They change the same quest stages, so the quest can stall.
Carries old copies of several weather records. Load it early so newer mods win.
